newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ budget in June, no comment on NZ dlr - Peters.
newsitem.headline: NZ budget in June, no comment on NZ dlr - Peters.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters said on Friday he aimed to deliver the government budget in the second or third week of June, but refused to be drawn on the level of the New Zealand dollar.

Peters was responding to questions after a speech in Auckland to the American Chamber of Commerce, in which he stressed the government's fiscal prudence and the importance of increasing national savings.

Asked for his view on the exchange rate and whether it should come down, Peters noted his New Zealand First party had been instrumental in widening the Reserve Bank's target range for underlying inflation to zero to three percent from 0-2 percent.
"That said, the Reserve Bank governor is in charge of monetary policy," he said. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
